programme.title: Andromeda: Det, vi ikke kan ændre
programme.desc: Et sort hul slår Dylan ud og sender ham ind i en alternativ virkelighed med kone og barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den skønne ukendte
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en af de længe forsvundne grundlæggere af Commonwealth, men opdager, at hun måske er mere besværlig, end hun er værd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Udyrets mave
programme.desc: Et mytologisk rumuhyre forsøger at æde Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ridderen, døden og djævelen
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at befri en flåde af tilfangetagne skibe, men flåden er ikke sikker på, at den ønsker at blive befriet. Deres AI'er frygter, at nye kaptajner vil gøre dem til slaver.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ubesmittet opfattelse
programme.desc: Genitter angriber Tyrs kone og koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunnelen for enden af lyset
programme.desc: Med halvtreds parter om bord er Dylan vært for underskrivelsen af det nye rigsfællesskabs charter, men opdager snart, at der er ubudne gæster, der har til hensigt at stoppe underskrivelsen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvis hjulet er fastgjort
programme.desc: Beka og Tyr bliver overtaget af energien fra en dimensionstunnel. Dylan, Trance og Harper må redde dem, før de ødelægger skibet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skår
programme.desc: Dylan bliver anklaget for mord og skal rense sit navn, mens han finder delene af en vase, der siges at give ejeren "kosmos velsignelser

programme.title: Andromeda: Gal for at blive reddet
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en gruppe flygtninge, men opdager, at de har været udsat for regeringens eksperimenter og er ekstremt ustabile.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Beka's onkel stiller op til et embede i det nye Commonwealth, men et mordforsøg får besætningen til at agere som hans sikkerhed.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det ensomme og jævne sand
programme.desc: Da Andromeda bliver angrebet af pirater i rummet, bliver de reddet af et længe forsvundet rumskib fra Jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Krigshundene Slipfighter
programme.desc: Besætningen opdager, at en slyngelplanet, Marduk, har fremstillet masseødelæggelsesvåben.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den spedalskes kys
programme.desc: En lejemorder ved navn Leper er ude efter lederne af det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver hjemsøgt af et mystisk væsen, der kommer om bord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Andromeda: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programme.desc: Da en længe savnet kærlighed vender tilbage, forsvinder Tyr fra skibet for at beskytte hende mod en lejemorder.
programme.sub-title: And Your Heart Will Fly Away

programme.title: Andromeda: Den uovervindelige mand
programme.desc: Spiller i et alternativt univers, hvor Dylan er død, og Gaheris Rhade forsøger at reformere Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Den gruppe, der angreb Andromeda under den første underskrivelse af Commonwealth-charter, vender tilbage for at skabe mere ravage.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det mørke bagud
programme.desc: Trance gennemgår nogle forskellige scenarier og forsøger at finde et, hvor hendes besætningsmedlemmer ikke dør.

programme.title: Andromeda: Risiko-alt-punktet
programme.desc: Et kraftigere Andromeda skib eksploderer sandsynligvis på grund af sabotage, hvilket tvinger Dylans besætning til at redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den rigtige hest
programme.desc: Beka bringer både sin besætning og en hel planet i fare, da en tidligere kærlighed dukker op.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvad sker der med en udskudt rev?
programme.desc: Andromeda modtager et råb om hjælp fra Rev Bam.
programme.sub-title: Hvad sker der med en udskudt rev?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fresh Heir
programme.desc: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Will
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Head Games
programme.desc: A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed. Later, his wife told two different versions of the events which led to his death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Dangerq
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Speck of Evidence
programme.desc: On September 17, 1984, in a suburb of Tucson, Arizona, eight-year-old Vicki Hoskins left home on her pink bicycle to mail a letter for her mother. She never returned, but her slightly damaged bicycle was found nearby.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Beaten by a Hair
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Forensic scientists use evidence from her bedroom to direct police to a prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insulated Evidence
programme.desc: It's usually easy to determine how a criminal entered the crime scene. But in this case, it looked as if the killer vanished into thin air ? and perhaps he had.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Talking Skull
programme.desc: In 1987, a human skull and some bones were discovered at a Boy Scout Camp near Farmington, Missouri. Facial reconstruction aids the investigators in this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spreeq
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Common Thread
programme.desc: After 10 bodies turn up in Florida, one victim — 17-year-old Lisa McVey — is abducted but released. She leads police to the perpertrator, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: A woman who was known to have suffered from depression apparently took her own life. But her sister told police that, a year before her death, she said if anything were to happen to her there would be a note in the china cabinet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: On May 12, 1994, Crystal Perry was viciously murdered in her home in Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, 32, was later found guilty in the slaying.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: With Every Breath
programme.desc: Young Navajos in the Southwest were dying at an alarming rate. The tribe's medicine men provided investigators with a critical clue that would lead halfway around the world to a most unlikely killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Blood
programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his step daughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freedom Fighter
programme.desc: After the suspect was convicted of arson and murder, he maintained his innocence. He turned to law books in the prison library and set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing in Time
programme.desc: A woman is reported missing after a fight with her husband. Police suspect a man who reported a fire in his car. Two tiny drops of blood are found in the interior. Finally, a tiny clue inside the suspect's watchband helps solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hand Delivered
programme.desc: In 1995, San Diego police are baffled by a pair of hands found in a dumpster. Through further investigation, they determine that the hands are those of missing person Don Hardin.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Live Wire
programme.desc: A bomb, constructed to cause as much damage as possible, kills a victim with deadly force and flame. When a painstaking search yields some tiny clues, police are able to identify the killer as surely as if he'd signed them.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Fog
programme.desc: It was the single most deadly automobile accident in American history. Almost a hundred vehicles were involved, twelve people died and more than fifty people were injured. And it happened along a stretch of highway long known for dense, thick fog.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Logged
programme.desc: In 1989, the dead bodies of Joan Rogers and her two teenage daughters were found floating in Tampa Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Evidence
programme.desc: When police find the body of 11-year-old Krista Harrison, there are few clues to the killer's identity. But authorities are intrigued by unusual orange fibers embedded in clothing found near the victim.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed
programme.desc: It was a tragic twist of fate. Just days after a woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ring Him Up
programme.desc: In 1994, 19-year-old Shannon Melendi disappeared while at Emory University. Her disappearance remained a mystery for ten years, until new scientific testing cast a different light on Colvin "Butch" Hinton.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nailed
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Transaction Failed
programme.desc: When a dedicated, well-respected teacher disappeared, police had to determine if she'd gone on vacation without telling anyone or if she was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980's the federal penitentiary in Atlanta held some of the country's most notorious prisoners. Castro called them undesirables. The U.S. government called them detainees. In 1987 they staged a bloody revolt.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lasting Impressions
programme.desc: No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries
programme.desc: Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I'm Back in LA Bitches!
programme.desc: Slænget fejrer Kristin Cavallaris besøg i LA. Spændingerne vokser mellem Heidi & Audrina. Justin & Jason styrker deres venskab. En god nat bliver til en god morgen, da Brody og Audrina endelig sætter deres kemi på prøve.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: "Who Slept at Your House?"
programme.desc: Da Kristin udspørger Brody om hans "sleepover" med Audrina, svirrer rygterne, og Kaitlynn føler sig udenfor. Caroline konfronterer Kaitlynn over deres venskab, der ligger på is, og Jason hører, at Spencer sætter spørgsmålstegn ved hans ædruelighed.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Get Dessert and Bail
programme.desc: Brody og Audrinas flirt tager fart. Krigen mellem familien Pratt og Wahler når kogepunktet, mens Brandon er ude i kulden efter Danis kølige svar til, om de skal flytte sammen. Audrina og Heidis venskab står ved en skillevej.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Time Heals Not Some Things
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencer søger hjælp til deres skrantende økonomi. Mens Kaitlynns nye forhold stadig trives, truer en flirt fra Brandons fortid forholdet til Dani. Justin forsones med sin far efter en svær tid.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: That's Math Right There
programme.desc: Kaitlynns beslutning om at flytte sammen med sin fyr får alle til at undre sig over, hvad der foregår. Heidi & Spencer er bekymrede for deres firma, og mens Brandon revurderer sit forhold, indser Audrina nogle ting om Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: What About Me?
programme.desc: Ved Speidis helseretreat flyver rygterne om Kaitlynns graviditet. Brandon afslører chokerende nyt om sit forhold. Wahler-familien prøver at blive forsonet med Pratt-familien, der distraheres af mulige ændringer i deres eget liv.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Timing Is Everything
programme.desc: Kaitlynn fortæller Brody, at hun er gravid, men bekymrer sig om, at han og Kris skal mødes på retreatet. Pratts og Wahlers forholder sig endelig til den fejde, der har splittet gruppen.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Mob Wife Goes In
programme.desc: Georgia og Miles kommer tættere på hinanden, men ender det i tårer? Marissa bliver presset til sin 'mafiakone'-grænse og Joey og Lorena tager ned på stranden til den sidste ankomst!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Finale
programme.desc: Joey får sit livs chok, da en eks gør en spektakulær entré til den store finale, og Georgia bliver følelsesladet, men får hun sin lykkelige slutning med de andre par?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Zahida Wages War
programme.desc: Otte sexede singler opdager, at deres drøm om sommerkærlighed bliver et mareridt, når flere ekser end nogensinder kommer for at skabe kaos. Zahida kæmper med Maisie om Sean, men når den første eks kommer, bliver det et værre blodbad.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: A Sea Of Tears
programme.desc: Det syder i villaen, når ikke bare en, men tre ekser ankommer og skaber kaos for turtelduerne Ross og Harriette. Zahidas eks Joe mister kontrollen, og Alex truer med at drukne sig i tårer.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Love Triangle
programme.desc: Singlernes elendighed fortsætter, da Sean springer fra Zahida til Zaralena, og Harriettes kærlighedstrekant bliver værre. Maisie vil have, der skal ske noget, og Aaron fra 'Geordie Shore' gør en storslået entré, men hvem af ekserne er hans?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Nicole's Nightmare
programme.desc: Spændingerne i villaen når kogepunktet, da Zaralena får Zahidas vrede at føle. Den nye eks får fyrene til at føre sig territorialt. Josh har et godt øje til Nicole, men slutter det, da hun opdager en knusende hemmelighed?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Blonde Bombshell
programme.desc: Adam afslører sine følelser for Nicole, og Jack og Josh vil have nyt blod i villaen. Zaralena og Aaron kommer tættere på hinanden, og Ross og Harriette tilbringer natten i loftslejligheden. Men en ny eks kan ødelægge det for alle.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Heartache
programme.desc: Terrortabletten gør livet surt for Becca. Harriettes hjertesorg bliver værre, og Zaralenas elendighed fortsætter, men det er den nyeste eks, der truer med at skabe det værste kaos.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Truth Comes Out
programme.desc: Ankomsten af endnu en eks fører til et blodbad i villaen. Nicole må høre sandheden om Jacques Fraser, mens Ross og Harriette skændes igen. Og Zaralena tager en stor beslutning.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Jacques Comeuppance
programme.desc: Jacques Fraser får omsider sin straf. Det nyeste ekser stormer stranden og villaen, skaber splid mellem Sean og Zahida og skaber kaos for resten.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Aaron Moves On
programme.desc: Der kommer to nye ekser, til Aarons glæde og Beccas fortvivlelse. Maisie når bunden, Harriette får et sammenbrud og Sean og Jack kommer ryger i totterne på hinanden.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Terrortabletten holder et stort græsk bryllup for Sean og Zahida, men da den sidste eks kommer, bliver festen kaotisk. Harriette får en chokerende besked af Ross.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bobby's Dilemma
programme.desc: Søgen efter kærlighed begynder på Mexicos strande. Chelsea socialite Daisy klistrer sig op ad Aaron, og Bobby fra Essex bager på Rhianne, men vil den første eks sabotere det hele?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Datingen fortsætter, da Bobby og Bayley tager sig en snak. Arrons får øje på noget godt, men forlader han Daisy? De tre nye ryster villaen, og en skal væk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Heartbreak And Happiness
programme.desc: Aaron bryder væk fra Daisy, men kan han overvinde Dominika? En ny eks kommer og truer med at ødelægge Bobby og Bayleys forhold.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Double Departure
programme.desc: Bobby får sit hjerte knust af Bayley, og Daisy trøster ham med glæde. Aaron bager på Dominika, og en VIP-ankomst bringer dramatik til villaen, da et par skal hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Daisy's Disaster
programme.desc: Vil en ny ankomst gøre Josiah glad? Daisy får et dobbelt slag, da hendes eks går videre med Natalee og hendes venskab med pigerne går i stykker.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bobby's Revenge
programme.desc: En ny ankomst giver George problemer og Bobby en chance for at få hævn. Natalee søger grønt lys fra Daisy til at være sammen med Matty, og Aaron leger med ilden på en date for tre.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Messages From Home
programme.desc: Daisy håber, at en ny fyr vil være hendes prins. Bobby bliver varm på Rhianne igen, og en 'eks-tra' kraft kommer på banen for første gang.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bayley's Home Truths
programme.desc: Alex får chancen for romantik med den nye 'skøre' Dominika. Natalee og Matty kommer tættere på hinanden, og en ny ankomst kan blive enden for George og Bayley.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Day Of The Dead Finale
programme.desc: Det er De dødes dag-finalefesten. Kan de originale piger rejse som venner? Vil nogle af parrene overleve? Eller vil en sidste ankomst få villaen til at gå helt i opløsning?

programme.desc: I dette afsnit pimper teamet Brians Honda CRX. Det er den første bil, der får en ny motor fordi den gamle motor dør før Xzibit kan få bilen hen på værkstedet.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: Gaby ejer intet andet end sin yogamåtte og en 1972 Land Cruiser, som hun købte af sin eks for 200 dollar. Drengene begynder med det ydre...

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: I dette afsnit pimper teamet Kerrys Ford Escort. Bilen består af to halvdele af to forskellige Ford Escorts, der er blevet svejset og "klistret" sammen. Teamet mener, den er for farlig at køre rundt i...

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1984 Cadillac Eldorado
programme.desc: Xzibit takes a beat-up 1984 Cadillac Eldorado and restores it to it's former glory.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1991 Ford Escort
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and the boys at West Coast Customs transform a '91 Ford Escort into a European luxury mobile.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1958 VW Bus
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and West Coast Customs give a 1958 VW some California love, and turn it into the ultimate beach ride.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Jelly AF
programme.desc: Der bliver kaos i huset, da Kareems tiltrækning af Zoe får Alivia til at bryde ud i gråd. Alles nerver er på højkant, da pigerne vælger at følge en strategi til parceremonien.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Don't Come at Me Crazy
programme.desc: Jada bliver rasende, da Uche angriber hende for at lægge an på Clinton. To 'on-off'-par finder sammen igen. Pigernes familier afslører pinlige oplysninger.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Sinking Relation-ships
programme.desc: Nurys kan ikke klare, at Malcolm og Diandra finder sammen. Huset er splittet mellem par, der nægter at splitte op, og singler, der har svært ved at knytte bånd.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tra Cray
programme.desc: Kareem og Alexis presses til bristepunktet, da Alivia og Keith udforsker, om de er et perfekt par. Ekser kommer med afsløringer, inklusive en eks, der allerede ved besked.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Tale of Two Players
programme.desc: Audrey bliver paranoid, da hun ser Michael skabe kontakt til Geles. Malcolm får ballade, fordi han er en player, og huset begynder at udforske nye forbindelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: No Love in Nola
programme.desc: Jalousi kommer i centrum til en vild Mardi Gras-fest. Geles bliver fjende nummer et, da hun bager på flere fyre i huset. Dimitri provokerer Jada.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers
programme.desc: Tyler vil gerne ud af venneboblen med Nicole. Shad viser nogle følelser. Der er knuste hjerter og jalousi i huset, og de beder Keith om at finde en vinderstrategi.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Den sidste parceremoni nærmer sig hastigt, så huset er desperat for at få de rigtige par ind i sandhedsbåsen og finde de 11 rigtige par. Keith og Alexis presser hinanden lige til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One
programme.desc: Vært Terrence J giver os et eksklusivt kig på denne sæsons medvirkende i AYTO og afslører, hvorfor de 22 singler er elendige til forhold.
programme.sub-title: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 1
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 2
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Leap of Fate
programme.desc: 22 singler tager springet og flytter ind i et hus på Hawaii for at prøve at finde 11 perfekte par og vinde en million dollar. Jalousi spreder sig, når par dannes hurtigt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Flirt at Your Own Risk
programme.desc: Zak provokerer Bria, når han flirter med andre kvinder, og hele huset bliver inddraget i dramaet. Tevin og Kenyas letsindige opførsel truer deres spirande forhold.

programme.title: Are You The One?: With Frenemies Like These...
programme.desc: Zak udforsker sine muligheder, mens kvinderne slås om hans opmærksomhed. Kenya og Jasmine bliver officielt fjender.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name
programme.desc: Asia bliver såret, når hun finder ud af, hvad hendes ven og fyren, hun er vild med, gjorde bag hendes ryg. Cali og Bretts spirende romance bringes i fare af deres dårlige vaner.
programme.sub-title: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tracurricular Activities
programme.desc: Huset bliver rystet, da deres ekser dukker op for at få noget kvalitetstid. Bølgerne går højt, når en eks truer med at splitte et stærkt par ad. Zak er splittet mellem Bria og Morgan.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Spilling The Tea
programme.desc: Kwasi starter drama, da han afslører, hvad Tevin og Jasmine gjorde natten før. Bria bliver sur over Morgan og Zaks forhold. Huset tager nogle risikable parvalg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: He Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Cam begynder at tvivle på sit forhold til Kayla. Daniels små lege skubber Sam væk. Huset oplever deres vigtigste sandhedsbås indtil nu.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beast Mode
programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt mellem Cam og Kwasi, da Kwasi lægger an på Kayla. Asia eksploderer, da hun tror, at nogle folk i huset er falske. Zak må træffe et valg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I Want You To Want Me
programme.desc: Nutsa er vild med Brett, men det får konsekvenser for hele huset, at Brett ikke kan glemme Cali. Moe bliver presset til at spille spillet, og Lewis afslører sine sande følelser for Asia.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Want Me

programme.title: Are You The One?: Master Plan
programme.desc: Brias besættelse af Zak truer husets evne til at spille spillet. Cali finder på en plan, der skal afsløre, hvilke magtpar, der er perfekte sammen, og hvem der ikke er.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time
programme.desc: Til en vild fest gør tvivlsom opførsel bedste venner til fjender. Tevin og Kenya gør sig klar til at få opklaret deres skæbne. Moe bliver presset til at tage sig sammen.
programme.sub-title: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
programme.sub-title: Now You See Me, Now I Don't

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.
programme.sub-title: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College

programme.title: JFK
programme.desc: Da distriktsanklager Jim Garrison (Kevin Costner) nærlæser rapporten om mordet på præsident Kennedy, får han mistanke om, at der ligger mere bag end det, der er offentligt kendt.

programme.title: Far From Home
programme.desc: Den tidligere barnestjerne Drew Barrymore havde sin første teenagerrolle i denne skæve thriller med komiske overtoner.

programme.title: Blood Brother
programme.desc: Jake goes to prison to protect his friends and his best friend Chris turns his life around to become a police officer. When Jake is released after 15 years, he seeks revenge.

programme.title: The Motorcycle Diaries (Diarios De Motocicleta)
programme.desc: Følg Ernesto "Che" Guevaras liv på et livsforandrende road trip gennem Sydamerika.

programme.title: Certified Copy
programme.desc: En kvinde og en forfatter udforsker identitet og kærlighed i Toscana. Romantik med Juliette Binoche.

programme.title: Upside of Anger
programme.desc: Den midaldrende husmor Terrys liv bliver vendt på hovedet, da hendes mand pludselig flytter til Sverige med sin sekretær. Snart begynder Terry at føle sig tiltrukket af mandens bedste ven, den tidligere baseballstjerne Denny.

programme.title: The Lunchbox
programme.desc: I Mumbai bringer en frokostlevering to skæbner sammen: Enkemanden, Saajan, modtager ved en fejl den frokost som husmoderen, Ila, har tilberedt til sin mand. Måltidet bliver starten på en brevudveksling i madkassen om passion, længsel og fremtidshåb.

programme.title: Bare Juliet
programme.desc: Annie (Rose Byrne) er kørt træt i sit parforhold med Duncan (Chris O'Dowd), der er kæmpefan af musikeren Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). Da en demoversion af Tuckers gamle hit LP dukker op, bliver det starten på et nyt møde med den flyvske kunstner.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Da en opdagelsesrejsendes søgen efter en diamantmine ender tragisk i Congo, sender hans far og ekpeditiones CEO Dr. Karen Roos ud i junglen for at fortsætte jagten... Måske på hans søn, men helt sikkert på diamanterne.

programme.title: Crossworlds
programme.desc: En ung mand befinder sig midt i en universel kamp mellem godt og ondt, da han slår sig ned i en transdimensional dal. Kun hans fars gådefulde krystalvedhæng og det tilhørende scepter kan sikre sejren.

programme.title: Centurion
programme.desc: Quintus er romersk centurion. Sammen med sine mænd er han fanget i fjendeland, omringet af stammefolket picterne. På hjemmebane er picterne en svær modstander, og Quintus og hans mænd må kæmpe vel vidende, at hvert øjeblik kan blive deres sidste.

programme.title: All About The Money
programme.desc: To uheldige venner bliver overtalt af en tredje til at tage på ferie i Columbia. Da de kommer frem, bliver de klar over turens egentlige formål: at forsøge at fange en colombiansk narkobaron.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When law enforcement officers become targets, no one is safe. So when a crystal meth dealer on the run from the law began shooting cops, it took more than police to stop him.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Women are most often assaulted by someone they know. Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender. Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Too often, convicted felons learn new techniques and find new partners in prison. In 1982, a group of former inmates began a spree of kidnapping and robbery.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A kidnapping can shatter a family, bringing terror and heartache without warning. In 1984 with the flash of a gun, an ordinary business transaction became a violent abduction. In seconds, the son of a wealthy Miami developer was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980's the federal penitentiary in Atlanta held some of the country's most notorious prisoners. Castro called them undesirables. The U.S. government called them detainees. In 1987 they staged a bloody revolt.

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Teenagerne Eddie og Amber vokser op i en lille irsk by i løbet af 1990'erne. Alle har mistanke om at de er homoseksuelle, og hver dag er en kamp. De mødes og lader som om og indser at et opdigtet forhold kan være mindst lige så kompliceret som et rigtigt.

programme.title: Now Add Honey
programme.desc: Carolines liv er i fuldstændig frit fald. Hendes døtre driver hende til vanvid, og hendes utaknemmelige chef løber ud af hende, mens hendes mand forlader hende.

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en meget succesfuld sælger, stresser over at få en stor handel. For at hjælpe hende skal hun slå sig sammen med Jonathan, der har travlt med at skabe en magisk jul til sin kæreste. Konflikten er givet, men noget andet begynder også at gry...

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Nogen er gået for vidt med din kærlighed til efterfølgere! Favoritfigurerne fra SCARY MOVIE er tilbage i en film, der skræmmer til mere uærbødig morskab end originalen med sin version af kliche-spøgelsesfilm.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: På en ferie møder den kiksede teenager Nick Twisp drømmepigen Sheeni. Nick, der ikke tidligere har haft held med piger, vil gøre alt for at vinde hendes hjerte og opfinder et alter-ego, den flamboyante og dristige Francois Dillinger.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Ron Burgundy, en kendt nyhedsvært i San Diego i 70'erne, mener ikke, at kvinder hører til i nyhedslokalet, så da Ron får en kvik og køn kvindelig kollega, er der dømt krig!

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: En rig families "sorte får" møder en ung psykiatrisk patient, der er vokset op isoleret hele sit liv. Han tager den naive unge kvinde med hjem til sin brors bryllup.

programme.title: The Giant Mechanical Man
programme.desc: To ensomme sjæle finder kærlighed og en forbindelse midt i storbyens kaos. En hjertevarm fortælling om kunst, skæve eksistenser og humor.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Will erfarer, at hans kæreste Amy har en affære med undertøjsmodellen Flavor. Da Will efterfølgende holder en fest kommer Amy med sin nye flamme. Pludselig begynder alt at ryste. Det viser sig, at jorden på samme tid rammes af alle naturkatastrofer.

programme.title: The Kids Are All Right
programme.desc: the kids are all right Det lesbiske ægtepar Nic og Jules havde den perfekte familie. Men de får sig et chok, da husets to teenagebørn opsøger den sæddonor, der er deres biologiske far. En øko-hippie ved navn Paul. En ren feel-good komedie.

programme.title: On the Case: The Day After Christmas
programme.desc: A man and his girlfriend are attacked by a mysterious intruder in their home. Despite near fatal wounds, she survives and helps investigators solve the crime.

programme.title: COPS: We Know Who You Are
programme.desc: Officers respond to a mental health crisis, a man runs from police when approached, and officers recognize a burglary suspect as someone they've tangled with before.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Episode 208 - Investment Fraud (Butler)
programme.desc: A crooked investment manager targets over 70 elderly individuals.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When a hostile online feud turns deadly, detectives' hunt for a mysterious CIA operative leading to the discovery of a jaw-dropping and vengeful catfishing scheme.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Stripped for Cash
programme.desc: When a rotting corpse is discovered in the trunk of a car, detectives uncover a sordid plot that includes a nouveau riche computer geek and a pair of seasoned golddiggers.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Namaslay
programme.desc: When she's caught stealing, an aspiring 20-something lifestyle blogger tries to prevent herself from being fired and gets locked up for murder instead.

programme.title: Under Arrest: No Smoking
programme.desc: An officer needs emergency assistance, a major drug house is raided and a prowler is captured by the K-9 unit.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Both natural disease and sports injury are likely suspects in Eric Brody's death. But then Dr. G learns that he was treated with antibiotics for a spider bite prior to his death.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: On October 20, 2014, white Chicago PD Officer Jason Van Dyke fatally shoots 17-year-old African American Laquan McDonald in an act that he and the Chicago PD called "self-defense".

programme.title: Under Arrest: Lovely Summer Night
programme.desc: Police investigate telephone threats, a vehicle stop turns deadly and a burglar is assaulted by a homeowner.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Victoria Climbie
programme.desc: A shocking look at the murder of eight-year-old Victoria Climbie, who was tortured and killed by her guardians in North London in 2000.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Murders are rare in tranquil Delta Township, Michigan. So when a well-liked couple is gunned down in their home, residents are terrified--until police discover the monster accidentally left a trail of breadcrumbs leading right to his door.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When a loving wife and mother are found stabbed to death inside her home, a team of investigators dedicates eight years to finding her killer. Ultimately, an undercover sting operation uncovers a world of lies, betrayal, and terror.

programme.title: Partners In Crime: The Moors Murders
programme.desc: Once jailed Myra Hindley focused all her energies into trying to get released.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: A diabetic man dies after a night out. Meanwhile, an elderly man's decomposing body is found in his son’s home. Dr. G realizes that finding the causes of death will be anything but straightforward.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Episode 4
programme.desc: Maggots that have eaten away the face of an unknown victim could turn out to be the key to solving the brutal murder.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Gaslighter
programme.desc: A cupcake-baking homemaker gets away with murder. That is, until she tries it on husband number two.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Reed Baley is found unconscious the morning after his bachelor party. Now, it’s up to Dr. G to determine if alcohol was to blame or if there was another cause of death.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: John Sweeney
programme.desc: John Sweeney brutally murdered two of his girlfriends, dismembered their bodies and dumped them in canals. In a macabre twist, he hid clues in his abstract paintings, and five other girlfriends of his are currently still missing.

programme.title: Tourist Police: Tenerife
programme.desc: We join the Tourist Police braving the notorious “Veronica’s Strip” in the hedonistic and violent Playa Las Americas..

programme.title: Under Arrest: Mud Wrestlers
programme.desc: Suspect with an assault weapon terrorizes neighbors, a son with a knife threatens his father, police dog tracks a gang of vehicle thieves.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Fat Bandit
programme.desc: A string of bank robberies in Winnipeg confound local police. Most bank-robbers are addicts, usually quite thin. This new man doesn't fit the profile: this bandit is fat.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Maneater
programme.desc: An aspiring cannibal finds an online buddy who fantasizes about being eaten. And when the two men arrange a dinner where the guest of honor is also the main course, the macabre soiree turns into a horrifying bloodbath.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars

programme.title: South Park: Pragtsvinet og Bæ
programme.desc: Da PETA ødelægger South Parks maskot, splitter diskussionen om en erstatning skolen. Stan trues af P Diddy og bortvises fra byen for at at nægte at stemme.

programme.title: South Park: Help, My Teenager Hates Me!
programme.desc: Drengene finder ud af, at med glæden ved at spille Airsoft, følger udfordringen at skulle forholde sig til teenagere.

programme.title: South Park: Informativ mordporno
programme.desc: Drengene bruger spillet Minecraft til at forhindre sine forældre I at skade hinanden.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 1
programme.desc: Drengene befinder sig i et magisk land, hvor hele verdens fantasi ligger lige foran dem. Men en terrorplan truer med at ødelægge det hele.

programme.title: South Park: Den mexicanske glofrø fra det sydlige Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Som en del af skolearbejdet skal børnene finde ud af Vietnam og tror på en latterlig historie, som Stans onkel Jimbo finder på.
programme.sub-title: Den mexicanske glofrø fra det sydlige Sri Lanka

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer kvarteret
programme.desc: Som det eneste rige barn i byen, føler Token sig som et udskud, og detlykkes ham at tiltrække adskillige andre velhavende folk til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Rødtotter
programme.desc: Cartman lider af et tilfælde af 'Gingervitus' og tager kampen op mod forfølgelsen af hans rødhårede fæller.

programme.title: South Park: Goth Kids 3: Posørernes dag
programme.desc: Goth-ungerne sendes på en lejr for problembørn.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle bliver uvenner over en magisk trekant, som dukker op på en arkæologisk udgravning. Trekanten giver magt til at forandre Barbra Streisand til et forfærdeligt monster.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 3
programme.desc: Stan og Butters er strandet i Imaginationland og må kæmpe for livet mod en hær af onde kræfter. Kyle og Cartman er stadig i Pentagon.

programme.title: South Park: En million små fibre
programme.desc: Towelie skriver en bog, og den bliver udvalgt til Oprahs bogklub. Den bliver en bestseller for folk, som prøver at bekæmpe deres afhængighed.

programme.title: South Park: Døde kendisser
programme.desc: Michael Jacksons spøgelse nægter at acceptere sin hedengang og efterlader resten af de nylig afdøde berømtheder frustrerede i Skærsilden.

programme.title: South Park: Krøblingekamp!
programme.desc: Big Gay Al vender tilbage til South Park men bliver kasseret som spejderfører, fordi han er bøsse.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantændelse
programme.desc: Indbyggerne i South Park eksploderer tilfældigt. Stans far er et af tilfældene.

programme.title: South Park: Chef vender tilbage
programme.desc: Byen er begejstret, da Chef vender hjem efter at have rejst rundt i verden med 'The Super Adventure Club.'

programme.title: South Park: Faith Hilling
programme.desc: Den seneste meme-mode i byen er 'Faith Hilling', men trenden går af mode da Faith Hilling afbryder republikanernes præsidentdebat.

programme.title: South Park: Gnomer (underbukse-gnomer)
programme.desc: Drengene skal skrive en opgave til skolen. Tweek foreslår, at de skriver om gnomer, der besøger ham hver nat og stjæler hans underbukser.

programme.title: South Park: Den ustuearrest-bare
programme.desc: Led og ked af hvordan han bliver behandlet af sine forældre, tager den altid uskyldige Butters den nye vampyr-galskab til sig, lidt for entusiastisk.

programme.title: South Park: Den sidste meehicaner
programme.desc: Da et spil 'grænsekontrol' går galt antænder Butters mexicansk stolthed, men Cartman er ikke villig til at holde op, mens legen stadig er god.

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Kyle inviterer Butters i stedet for Cartman til sin fødselsdagsfest, så Cartman bilder Butters ind, at en meteor vil ramme jorden og lukker ham inde i et beskyttelsesrum, så han selv kan gå i stedet.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Den nye dreng i klassen overtaler Jesus til at slås med hans far, Satan, i det endelige slag mellem det gode og det onde. Cartman bliver rasende over at høre, at sammenstødet falder sammen med hans fødselsdagsfest.

programme.title: South Park: Cherokee hårtamponer
programme.desc: Kyle har brug for en nyretransplantation, og Cartman er den perfekte donor. Men Cartman sætter en høj pris på sin nyre: 10 millioner dollars.

programme.title: South Park: Det bryder løs
programme.desc: 'Du ved hvad' bryder løs, da indbyggerne i South Park hører ordet '****' i det populære show 'Cop Drama'.

programme.title: South Park: Seerkrigen
programme.desc: Drengene bliver inddraget i en seerkrig, da deres 'Super School News' er i fare for at blive nedlagt, og de vil bruge alle midler for at tiltrække seere.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans utrolige gave
programme.desc: Et uheldigt forsøg på at flyve bringer Cartman på hospitalet. Da politiet tror, at han har særlige overnaturlige evner for opklarelse af forbrydelser, ansætter de ham til hjælpe med at fange en seriemorder.

programme.title: South Park: Er du der, Gud, det er mig, Jesus
programme.desc: Cartman hævder, at han er kommet i puberteten til de andre drenges store misundelse, og Jesus lover at give folkene i South Park en nytårsforestilling.
programme.sub-title: Er du der, Gud, det er mig, Jesus

programme.title: South Park: Bvadr, en penis!
programme.desc: Ms. Garrison vil gerne være mand igen, så mens han er væk fra skolen, bliver Cartmann vikar.

programme.title: South Park: Højere standard
programme.desc: Cartman indrømmer endelig, at han er fed, og anskaffer sig en el-scooter.

programme.title: South Park: Rektor PC's endelige retfærdighed
programme.desc: Kyle prioriterer en farlig alliance højere end sit venskab med Stan.

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Cartman er overbevist om, at pigerne har et apparat, som kan se ind i fremtiden, så Butters klæder sig ud som pige for at infiltrere dem.

programme.title: South Park: Røde slæde styrtet
programme.desc: Med julemandens, Mr. Hankey og Jesus' hjælp, forsøger Cartman at bringe julen til Iraks underkuede befolkning.

programme.title: South Park: En helt elendig jul
programme.desc: Kyle og Ike venter spændt på Mr. Hankey. Da han ikke dukker op, ringer Kyle til de andre og indkalder til et sent krisemøde.

programme.title: South Park: Eric Cartman er død
programme.desc: Da alle beslutter sig for at ignorere Cartman, er han overbevist om, at han er død og må finde fred ved at undskylde for sine tidligere misgerninger.

programme.title: South Park: Wall-Mart er på vej
programme.desc: Da Wall-Mart forvandler South Park til en spøgelsesby, prøver Stan og Kyle at ødelægge forretningen, men en besat Cartman står dem i vejen.

programme.title: South Park: Coon vs. Coon og venner
programme.desc: 'The Coon' viser sig at være endnu ondere end den mørke mester Cthulhu, når han kræver hævn over sine tidligere partnere.

programme.title: South Park: Homoseksualitetens røde skilt
programme.desc: Hele South Park møder op til den årlige genopførelse af et slag fra borgerkrigen.

programme.title: South Park: Undskyld, Jesse Jackson
programme.desc: Randy bliver offentligt til grin ved at bruge n-ordet på direkte tv. Cartmann kan ikke modstå fristelsen til at drille en lille person, de kommer til skolen for at lære børnene om fordomme.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren
programme.desc: Dora læser en historie, om en Wizzle som kunne opfylde ønsker med hans tryllestav. På hans fødselsdag er det hans tur til at ønske, men hans tryllestav blæser bort i vinden. Dora har brug for din hjælp til at redde Wizzle's tryllestav.

programme.title: Kom så Diego!

programme.title: Blaze og Monstermaskinerne

programme.desc: Rod beviser, at han er en hane og ikke en kylling, da han finder en lille bjørneunge i den hjemsøgte grotte.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren
programme.desc: Ved en maskine i tivoliet ønsker Boots, at når han siger 'bananer', får han bananer. Hans ønske går i opfyldelse, men da bananerne bliver ved med at vælte ned, er han nødt til at ønske, at det skal holde op. Desværre er maskinen i stykker.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren
programme.desc: Dora og hendes venner må finde alle stjernebillederne efter en meteorregn har skræmt dem væk.
